tool_args.rationale: Acquire observations above the candidate critical gradient to determine whether an avalanche decline occurs and identify its parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot ends at s_grad 2.44, below the stated critical range, so it cannot identify the threshold or avalanche strength.
The pilot's monotone concave pattern does not distinguish these from a threshold mechanism outside the observed range.
A high-gradient probe more directly tests the unresolved threshold.
